nodes.label: Smooth regimes are learned
nodes.statement: Input-only GRU reconstructs subthreshold and synaptic dynamics far better than spike regimes.

nodes.label: Complete spike-amplitude collapse
nodes.statement: Across factorial 11 all models predict zero of 102 spikes and never exceed approximately -58 mV.

nodes.label: High-frequency power absent
nodes.statement: Prediction-to-teacher soma power above 50 Hz remains below 1.3 percent in every factorial cell.

nodes.label: MR-STFT improves slow manifold
nodes.statement: MR-STFT improves global, slow and subthreshold fidelity while leaving spike recall at zero.

nodes.label: Causal frontend fails
nodes.statement: The tested 7.5 ms CausalConv1d+GRU violates global, slow and subthreshold guardrails.

nodes.label: Event signal reaches latent/router
nodes.statement: Frozen latent and learned routers identify the broad spike regime, but continuous residual experts do not reconstruct narrow amplitude and phase.

nodes.label: Event-focused updates are scarce
nodes.statement: Only 8 of 456 optimizer updates per epoch in factorial 11 are stratified event windows.

nodes.label: Broadband objective is sufficient
nodes.statement: Adding MR-STFT to normalized-state MSE is sufficient to recover rare fast transitions.

nodes.label: Imbalanced regression causes mean collapse
nodes.statement: The objective transfers the dense subthreshold target prior into a conditional-mean prediction, suppressing rare extremes.

nodes.label: Event exposure is insufficient
nodes.statement: The optimizer receives too few event-centred updates to learn the rare transition without sacrificing common regimes.

nodes.label: Gradient conflict blocks a joint solution
nodes.statement: Event, subthreshold, slow and synaptic objectives induce conflicting or severely anisotropic gradients.

nodes.label: Optimization basin, not expressivity
nodes.statement: The current scaffold can express the transition but the optimizer converges to a smooth low-frequency basin.

nodes.label: Broad regime information is represented
nodes.statement: The recurrent latent represents whether the process is near a spike-support regime.

nodes.label: Fast phase is linearly represented
nodes.statement: Exact rapid phase and amplitude are directly decodable from the shared input-only latent.

nodes.label: Explicit state feedback is required
nodes.statement: The previous predicted physical state supplies transition information that an input-only hidden state does not preserve accessibly.

nodes.label: Short causal frontend solves the fast regime
nodes.statement: A 7.5 ms dilated CausalConv1d frontend before a GRU is sufficient to expose the missing fast structure.

nodes.label: Explicit mixed timescales help
nodes.statement: A standard state-space or continuous-time recurrent operator represents slow and fast dynamics more efficiently than a discrete GRU.

nodes.label: Sparse switching decomposition
nodes.statement: A slow continuous expert plus a gated fast residual expert can represent the process without explicit state feedback.

nodes.label: Four-node message passing
nodes.statement: Compartment-local transitions plus learned coupling are more data-efficient than a monolithic sequence model.

nodes.label: Some subsystems are separable
nodes.statement: Selected receptor transitions can be modelled locally while other coordinates require a global backbone; modularity is partial, not total.

nodes.label: Loss Landscape Observatory
nodes.statement: Measure regime-conditioned gradient geometry and local curvature on frozen factorial checkpoints.

nodes.label: Activation and Gradient Atlas
nodes.statement: Compare internal event separation, saturation, rank and block gradients across factorial cells.

nodes.label: Matched event exposure
nodes.statement: Compare uniformly sampled and event-balanced auxiliary windows at identical update counts.

nodes.label: Balanced MSE
nodes.statement: Test an established imbalanced-regression objective under a frozen scaffold and sampler.

nodes.label: Predicted-state feedback
nodes.statement: Compare input-only recurrence with a standard autoregressive state-space contract under equal initial information.

nodes.label: Fast-slow threshold microtask
nodes.statement: Measure whether a layer can integrate slow evidence and emit a narrow state-dependent transition.

nodes.label: Four-node propagation microtask
nodes.statement: Measure causal local updates and spatial coupling independently.
